text: {"frames":["A bell tolls under the fog, though the village it hung in drowned long before your grandmother was born. Edith, the learned owl from the mill, has bet you a jar of honey that it is only a bucket knocking in the reeds. She taps the sunken church wall with her beak and counts every toll out loud. Of the tolls she counted, {x} were true, and the water at your clogs goes still. What percentage of the tolls were true?","Keep your voice down, because the dyke watchman sleeps by day and wakes when you say his name. Gareth, the girl who collects fog in jars, holds one up to the lamp and grins. She says the silent watchman has never once been caught, and she bets her best jar against yours that she can catch him by evening. Her jar on the sill is filled to {x} of its measure, and the tide is coming in. How many per cent is {x}?","The cheese on the shelf has rolled off again, and the windows of the crooked house with the hoist beam glow gold though nobody is home. Mies the cheesemaker sits in the dark with her clogs off and her ladle ready. She has tied a thread from the door to the bell, and she is waiting for the thief who keeps stealing her wheels. Tonight the thief will walk in, and Mies has already planned the trick to catch him. What is {x} as a percentage?","The tower clock strikes an hour that does not exist, and the bells of the Tower fall silent. Nell, the boy with the blue lantern, runs up the spiral stairs after the stolen hour before it fades. Each floor she passes has a canal running across it, and a windmill turns on the landing where the hour must be hiding. She reaches the clock face, and the hands point to a gap with {x} of the dial still empty. What percentage of the dial is still missing?","Luuk, the old lock keeper, wants the last page of the Tower's book more than anything in the world. The book in the library floor keeps writing itself, and every new line is about the lock and the water behind it. He has waited all winter on the ice, and the ink has already reached {x} of the final page. What percentage of the page is written?"]}
